description:
crates/bedok has no executing physics or benchmark gate.

- crates/bedok/src/reference/cases/neacrp_a/mod.rs has 11 #[test] fns (lines 496, 505, 526, 538, 560, 578, 623, 640, 678, 703, 718). Every one is a case-BUILDER assertion: grid dims (nx==17, nz==18), axial mesh (z_total==427.3), material-map indices, TH inputs (max_power_watt == 693.75e6), rod-bank positions, feedback-table reference states, transient-schedule monotonicity, error on a coarse grid. NONE asserts k_eff, power, or flux.
- neacrp_a/tables.rs adds 6 more tests (lines 517-612), also data-integrity only.
- The physics gates exist but are all disabled: 19 #[ignore]d gates across crates/bedok/tests/benchmark/main.rs (7, e.g. :69 #[ignore = "waiting on the stage-1 reference solver"]) and tests/parity/main.rs (8). tests/benchmark/main.rs:36 states outright: "Not yet run. Every gate below is #[ignore]d".

So no parity claim can be made for bedok, and none should appear in any doc. Blocked on the seam rewiring bead.

Verified 2026-08-07 against the working tree.
title: bedok: no physics gate exists — 17 builder-only tests, 19 ignored gates never run
